effect.name: Scanlines
effect.description: Dark lines across the image, the CRT tell. On its own it is the cheapest way to make clean pixel art look like it came out of a tube.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Line Spacing
parameter.description: Texels from one line to the next. 2 gives the classic every-other-line look.

parameter.name: Line Width
parameter.description: Fraction of the spacing that is dark.

parameter.name: Darkness
parameter.description: How far the dark lines are pulled down.

parameter.name: Softness
parameter.description: 0 is a hard edged line, 1 is a smooth sine-like falloff.

parameter.name: Offset
parameter.description: Slides the lines along. Add a little each tick for a rolling signal.

parameter.name: Vertical
parameter.description: On draws the lines vertically instead, for an aperture-grille look.
